answer_protocol: fixed choices; one common Grok answer call; supplied evidence only
historical_protocol: known_at questions are issued before later sources are ingested in both systems; as_of questions use fact-time retrieval after all sources

capacity_targets.concurrency: one ingestion worker and sequential foreground reads

limitations: one realization per model and condition
fixed-choice answer accuracy is distinct from free-form answer quality
primary model and embedding align; consolidation algorithms and total token use differ
Hindsight observations and Acorn insights may have different granularity
